decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans Floor plan 1:100 submitted under 00896/A/P4 on 30/01/2006 and location plan, submitted under 00896/A/P4 on 24/03/2006, submitted  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for medical and non-medical services and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall be carried on only by Cranstoun and shall be for a limited period until 13 April 2018, or the period during which the premises are occupied by Cranstoun whichever is the shorter.
Condition : 5 - The counselling, treatment and training facilities hereby approved shall be available to clients on an appointments only basis.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby approved shall not be open to clients outside the following times: 10.00am to 6.00pm Mondays to Saturdays

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.
Condition : 8 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 9 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on the submitted site plan shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of cycle parking provision shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The spaces shall be provided before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 11 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of 2 wheelchair accessible parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The spaces shall be provided before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 12 - Before the use hereby permitted commences provision shall be made for disabled people to gain access to the building from the car park by the formation of ramps from the adjoining highway and car park access roads.
description: Variation of condition 4 (The use hereby permitted shall be carried on only by Crime Reduction Initiatives and shall be for a limited period being the period of 12 years from the date of this letter, or the period during which the premises are occupied by Crime Reduction Initiatives whichever is the shorter) of planning permission 00896/A/P4 dated 13/04/2006 to allow for a change of name to CRANSTOUN in place of CRT
